LESSON: CONSTRUCTING INNOVATIVE GARDENS GARDENS GARDENS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Production Techniques
Topic 4.2: Constructing Innovative Gardens gardens gardens

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Constructing Innovative Gardens gardens gardens. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Constructing Innovative Gardens gardens gardens
2. Practise Constructing Innovative Gardens gardens gardens at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Constructing Innovative Gardens gardens gardens

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Constructing Innovative Gardens gardens gardens
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Constructing Innovative Gardens gardens gardens. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Constructing Innovative Gardens gardens gardens at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Constructing Innovative Gardens gardens gardens at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Constructing Innovative Gardens gardens gardens
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Constructing Innovative Gardens gardens gardens. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Constructing Innovative Gardens gardens gardens using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Constructing Innovative Gardens gardens gardens in the examples.
2. Explain Constructing Innovative Gardens gardens gardens to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Constructing Innovative Gardens gardens gardens.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Constructing Innovative Gardens gardens gardens using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Constructing Innovative Gardens gardens gardens important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Constructing Innovative Gardens gardens gardens
2. Practise Constructing Innovative Gardens gardens gardens at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Constructing Innovative Gardens gardens gardens

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
